name: Animal Friendship
summary: Charms a Beast you can see if it fails a Wisdom saving throw.

stats.effect: Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spells ends.
stats.higherLevels: You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.
